about: Product-specific VST3 component floats, measured from public host APIs. Values are stored VST3 plain values, which need not equal displayed physical units. Component and controller envelopes, unknown float slots and private tails are retained.

layers: stored float32 controls and opaque tail

parameters/Style.about: VST3 parameter 5. Host display: 0 = Classic; 1 = Clean; 2 = Vocal; 3 = Guitar; 4 = Upward.

parameters/Release.about: VST3 parameter 7. Host display: 0 = 0.000 ms; 0.25 = 53.58 ms; 0.5 = 428.7 ms; 0.75 = 1.447 sec; 1 = 5.000 sec.

parameters/Knee.about: VST3 parameter 9. Host display: 0 = 0.00 dB; 7.5 = 7.50 dB; 15 = 15.00 dB; 22.5 = 22.50 dB; 30 = 30.00 dB.

parameters/Lookahead Enabled.about: VST3 parameter 11. Host display: 0 = Disabled; 0 = Disabled; 1 = Enabled; 1 = Enabled; 1 = Enabled.

parameters/Side Chain Input Signal.about: VST3 parameter 16. Host display: 0 = Normal input; 0 = Normal input; 1 = Side chain input; 1 = Side chain input; 1 = Side chain input.

parameters/Audition Side Chain.about: VST3 parameter 19. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Wet Level.about: VST3 parameter 20. Host display: -1 = -INF dB; -0.5 = -18.00 dB; 0 = 0.00 dB; 0.5 = +18.00 dB; 1 = +36.00 dB.

parameters/Dry Level.about: VST3 parameter 22. Host display: -1 = -INF dB; -0.5 = -18.00 dB; 0 = 0.00 dB; 0.5 = +18.00 dB; 1 = +36.00 dB.

parameters/Midi State.about: VST3 parameter 24. Host display: 0 = Enabled; 0 = Enabled; 1 = Disabled; 1 = Disabled; 1 = Disabled.

parameters/Expert Mode.about: VST3 parameter 26. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Channel Mode.about: VST3 parameter 27. Host display: 0 = Left/Right; 0 = Left/Right; 1 = Mid/Side; 1 = Mid/Side; 1 = Mid/Side.

parameters/Input Level.about: VST3 parameter 28. Host display: -1 = -INF dB; -0.5 = -18.00 dB; 0 = 0.00 dB; 0.5 = +18.00 dB; 1 = +36.00 dB.

parameters/Output Level.about: VST3 parameter 30. Host display: -1 = -INF dB; -0.5 = -18.00 dB; 0 = 0.00 dB; 0.5 = +18.00 dB; 1 = +36.00 dB.

parameters/Bypass.about: VST3 parameter 32. Host display: 0 = Not Bypassed; 0 = Not Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed.

parameters/Interface: Show Display.about: VST3 parameter 33. Host display: 0 = Hide Display; 0 = Hide Display; 1 = Show Display; 1 = Show Display; 1 = Show Display.
